title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Rulebook — Credit-Use Restoration Discount
content:
# Credit-use restoration discount — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**Rule.** On the restoration of a past-due Wayfare Pass membership, the credit-use restoration discount looks at the Pass ride credit the member spent on fares in the last six months: 3 percent at 8.00 or more, 1 percent at 4.00 or more but under 8.00, nothing under 4.00.

**Measure.** The credit spent is the total of the credit spent entries on the membership ledger dated in the last six months, each being Pass ride credit that paid a fare, taken as a positive amount.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the restoration payment as that percentage of the membership fee the payment collects for the period in force; the percentage is of that membership fee amount itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the payment is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Tiers with both edges

| Credit spent on fares in the last six months (USD) | Discount |
|---|---|
| 8.00 or more | 3 percent |
| 4.00 or more, under 8.00 | 1 percent |
| under 4.00 | nothing |

- 8.00 spent: 3 percent; 7.99 spent: 1 percent.
- 4.00 spent: 1 percent; 3.99 spent: nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A Wayfare Pass Annual member restoring a payment that collects a fee amount of 64.00, having spent 9.40 of credit on fares in the last six months: 3 percent of 64.00 is 1.92, leaving 62.08.
